svg.title: A slowly turning orbit
svg.desc: Three aligned-focus ellipses have progressively rotated perihelia. Their offset is greatly exaggerated. The curves are schematic successive Kepler ellipses, compressed vertically for layout, not a numerical integration of an exact relativistic orbit. The text derives the small secular advance and states its regime.

g.text: An ellipse whose closest point slowly rotates
A leading-order orbit picture, with precession greatly enlarged.
